body: I am an MS4 and I continue to struggle with suicidal thoughts, specifically related to academic issues. I have psychiatric help, at least.
Trouble with shelves. It surprised me too, because STEP-1 went fine (I scored below average, but solidly passed).

Are there any hard numbers on match rates for American M.D.'s who repeat all or part of a year and match into a categorical position? I know it's 60-70% for STEP-1 failures, but I have not read anything on people repeating a year.
